VinClub is a loyalty program that offers many exclusive privileges for members. In particular, during the birthday month and when upgrading the card, customers also receive attractive promotional vouchers to fully enjoy the Vinpearl - VinWonders ecosystem.

1. VinClub card upgrade benefits

When upgrading VinClub membership, customers will be given preferential vouchers corresponding to each card class, applicable when purchasing VinWonders tickets or using services at Vinpearl:

Gold Rank | Platinum Class | Diamond class

Voucher 200,000 VND | Voucher 300,000 VND | Voucher 500,000 VND

Note: Applicable when purchasing services on VinWonders website/app Voucher validity: within 03 months from the date of receipt of voucher

2. Birthday gifts for VinClub members

On the occasion of their birthday, VinClub offers members special promotional vouchers:

Gold Rank | Platinum Class | Diamond class

Voucher 200,000 VND | Voucher 300,000 VND | Voucher 500,000 VND

Applicable to customers who already have date of birth data in their account before their birthday.

Step 2: Proceed to add products to cart

Step 3: In the promotion section, apply the voucher code "Happy birthday with VinWonders"/ "Congratulations on card upgrade"

Step 4: Complete payment, ready to receive tickets via Email/SMS

Step 2: Access the "Account" section, select "My offers" - Vinpearl section
